title: Arms & Armor
subtitle: Forged in blood
text: Hemomancy provides several tiers of equipment, each with distinct crafting methods and strengths. Early on you will forge Hematic Iron gear from blood-infused iron. As you progress, you will encounter Barbed and Chitinite armor harvested from the creatures of the infection, and eventually the fearsome Blood Lust set. Each tier reflects a deeper understanding of blood.
